_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. See lib/models/father_week_derive.dart. Adding one of those keys here overrides the derivation for that section only.

title.en: She may want less, not more
title.hi: उन्हें कम चाहिए हो सकता है, ज़्यादा नहीं

body.en: Advice, visitors, plans. Around now many mothers want the world quieter. Being the person who says no on her behalf is a real job and it is yours.
body.hi: सलाह, मेहमान, योजनाएँ। इन दिनों बहुत सी माँएँ चाहती हैं कि दुनिया थोड़ी शांत हो जाए। उनकी तरफ़ से मना कर देने वाला इंसान बनना एक असली काम है, और वह आपका है।
